seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The party forms as novice couriers in Hallia, stumbling into a conspiracy of Ugathul infiltrators, illegal augury, and radar dishes while becoming consultants for the Magical Crimes Convox. The arc culminates in a disastrous ambush at the Crowded Flea that leaves three party members dead in a near-total party kill.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: Johnny and Benny navigate the void between life and death, forge a pact with the entity Aut, and return to exact revenge on Hlarf and Tywelwyn Leatherhide — uncovering a plot by six Thessian gods to crack the Firmament. The rescue of Anaïs reveals the cosmic Narrative and its five warring siblings, reframing everything the party thought they knew about their patron.

seasons.title: Keystones and Fractures
seasons.arc_summary: The party attends a mysterious pilgrimage gathering at Ragged Roost, competing in gladiatorial trials and solving puzzles to earn a keystone granting passage aboard a colossal Strider. During the subsequent downtime, they discover a hairline fracture in reality beneath Teller's Run imprisoning a colossal deity, and bomb the research facility attempting to shatter the Firmament — triggering the keystone's activation and the Strider's imminent departure.

seasons.title: The Strider
seasons.arc_summary: Aboard the colossal Strider on its voidward pilgrimage, the party builds a Fane, navigates deadly faction politics and tithes, allies with the ancient Machine God deep in the Undercroft, and battles Herald cultists and corrupted hearts. The arc ends catastrophically when the party accidentally destroys the Menhir — a member of the cosmic Narrative — flinging the Strider far off the atlas to a dead, godless world.

seasons.title: Far Starward
seasons.arc_summary: Stranded on a scoured world beyond all known maps, the party rallies surviving factions, frees a half-minotaur gunslinger from the Herald's song, assaults the Strider's corrupted spire, and pursues Anzu's sister Galzu through a surreal Fane of Aurelia's memories. With the Strider still immobilized and a captured Herald cultist growing more powerful by the day, the party seeks phlogiston fuel at the abandoned Hesperid mining outposts — discovering a tessellated ghost ship trapped across six timelines.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Fall of the Terror
seasons.arc_summary: The 8th-grade heroes of Cagley Middle descend into Mt. Cagley and slay the shadow demon Terror, saving the town before getting in trouble with their parents. The session then pivots to a new arc as four elite Scale operatives are dispatched to a shattered Joker World to investigate a mysterious slip-shielded structure.

seasons.title: The Quorum and the Voice of Many
seasons.arc_summary: The Scale team breaches the fiend-built Quorum, solves its monolith puzzles, and battles through Sigzilheight's forces to discover Voice of Many — a trapped divine heart and child of Sigzil. After a desperate ten-round defense against the Keeper of Chains, they free the entity and escape back to headquarters.

seasons.title: The Husk Murders
seasons.arc_summary: The convox detectives travel to the logging town of Wrenford to investigate a wave of husk-murders, follow a Feyrock necklace into the mile-tall Verdant Expanse, and battle through giant mantises, a laughing wave, and a fey Court of Masks — only to learn the curse continues unabated.

seasons.title: The Gloaming Codex
seasons.arc_summary: Pivoting from the wilderness to the city, the detectives trace fey-stone leads through a jeweler's conference and a suspect's apartment to the Gloaming Codex — a book that drags the entire party into its pages to fight carnivorous ink and cursed thoughts.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: Sedecium's Fire Team
seasons.arc_summary: Three Sedecium agents — the wizard Old Man Scrazzy, goblin gunslinger Lieutenant Foral, and orcish guardian Ozzie — investigate a slip-sunken observatory station and uncover the Thessian Esoterica's interest in a massive magical spike near the Astra's core, then are pulled into a perilous raid to steal divine essence from a freshly-killed god before the God Eater Harrow devours it whole.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
